title: M5Stack Core2 · K010
summary: ESP32 双核触摸终端，带 2 英寸屏幕、AXP192、MPU6886、音频与 500 mAh 电池；不同 USB 芯片版本按厂家说明记录。

facts.label: SoC
facts.value: ESP32-D0WDQ6-V3 @ Xtensa® 32-bit LX6 dual-core processor, clock frequency 240MHz

facts.label: Button
facts.value: Power button, RST button, screen virtual buttons x 3

facts.label: USB Chip
facts.value: CP2104/CH9102F (two chip versions, no functional or usage differences)

facts.label: Charging Parameters
facts.value: Charging current: 0.219A; Fully charged current (powered off): 0.055A; Fully charged current (powered on): 0.147A

facts.label: SPI NOR flash (host board schematic)
facts.notes: The ESP32 symbol names GPIO6-11 SD_*, which are the hard-wired SPI flash pads; they are unrelated to the microSD socket.

facts.label: Quad SPI PSRAM (host board schematic)
facts.notes: CS# and SCLK move to GPIO16/GPIO17 for the second SPI device while the four data lanes stay shared with the flash pads.

facts.label: LCD 10-pin display connector nets

value.seriesResistors: 47R on MOSI/MISO/SCK/CS (R61-R64 in the v1.0 drawing)

facts.notes: RST and backlight are PMIC outputs, not ESP32 GPIOs: the driver must release reset and enable the backlight through the power IC named in this record.

facts.label: microSD socket nets

wiring: G4 (10K pull, R26 in the v1.0 drawing)
socket switch pad; no ESP32 net name visible in the text layer

facts.notes: The socket shares the SPI bus with the LCD panel; the two devices are separated by their chip selects (G4 vs G5).

facts.label: Internal I2C roster (G21 SDA / G22 SCL)

devices: INT on G39, RST on AXP_IO4

facts.notes: Reference designators in the v1.0 drawing: U4 = AXP192, U5 = BM8563, CTP1 = 2.0 inch capacitive panel. Addresses follow the official PinMap; the drawing shows the SDA/SCL nets G21/SYS_SDA and G22/SYS_SCL.

facts.label: I2S amplifier and PDM microphone
facts.notes: LRCK and the PDM clock share GPIO0: the I2S transmit path and the microphone PDM path cannot be sampled simultaneously on the same pad.

facts.label: RTC and its interrupt
facts.notes: The interrupt is a PMIC output, so an alarm cannot be observed from an ESP32 GPIO.

facts.label: AXP192 output assignment
facts.notes: Official PinMap names these as AXP_* rails; M5GFX/M5Unified name the same roles gpio3/gpio2/dcdc3/ldo2/ldo3/gpio1. The AXP names are kept here because the manufacturer table is the source.

facts.label: Buttons and level

reset.net: EN/RST on the 2x15 header pin 6 (RST EN), MCU CHIP_PU via R5/MCU_RST

value.virtual: Three on-screen buttons drawn on the touch layer; no GPIO behind them

facts.notes: The three screen buttons are touch regions, so they must be injected through the touch controller, not GPIO input.

facts.label: M5-Bus 2x15 header, pin by pin
facts.notes: Left column is odd pins 1-29, right column even pins 2-30; NC pads carry no net name.

facts.label: HY2.0-4P port wiring
facts.notes: PORT.B/PORT.C are reached through the 2x15 expansion header/bottom accessory; only PORT.A is a socket on the host body in the base SKU drawings.

facts.label: USB-to-serial bridge
facts.notes: Two bridge chip versions are documented with no functional difference.

value.charge: AXP192 CHG pin 36 / ACIN from VBUS
value.indicator: Green LED on AXP192 IO1 (net SYS_LED)

revisions.changes: Manufacturer release note: the LCD panel changed from ILI9342C to ILI9342E; M5GFX >= 0.2.27 is required when compiling. Both controller datasheets list a 320RGB x 240 window, so the geometry does not change but the initialization/ID path does.
revisions.hardwareRevision: Base Core2 SKU; batch depends on the production date (ILI9342C until 2026-08-07, ILI9342E after).

unknowns.notes: Catalog identity does not infer the revision owned by the user.

unknowns.label: PCB physical layout
unknowns.notes: No complete populated PCB layout or Gerber verified in the audited files. A manufacturer mechanical board outline, when present, does not establish every component or copper trace. Unknown internals remain a neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.

unknowns.label: MPU6886 interrupt routing
unknowns.notes: The official Core2 PinMap lists only SDA/SCL for the IMU and the v1.0 text layer does not name an ESP32 net for the MPU6886 INT pad, so interrupt wiring is not claimed.

unknowns.label: microSD card-detect pin
unknowns.notes: The socket's Detect pad appears in the drawing but no ESP32 GPIO net name is readable in the text layer; card presence is therefore not modelled as a GPIO.

unknowns.label: Panel initialization register values
unknowns.notes: Neither the schematic nor the PinMap lists the per-controller register sequence; only the 320x240 window, SPI pads and reset/backlight ownership are verified.

unknowns.label: Flash/PSRAM SPI mode at runtime
unknowns.notes: The drawing proves pad wiring only; whether firmware runs DIO/QIO comes from the boot header, not the schematic.
